name: tandarr
description: Tandarr is a LAN movie night picker. Swipe through your Plex library Tinder-style with friends to find movies everyone wants to watch. Connect to your Plex server, create a room, set filters, and start swiping. When everyone swipes right on the same movie, it's a match!

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Persistent storage for configuration and library cache

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the Tandarr web interface

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: Plex server URL (e.g., http://192.168.1.50:32400). Optional — can also configure via web UI.

variables.name: Plex Token
variables.description: Plex authentication token. Optional — can also configure via web UI.
